inputs.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds, <Picture 1> is fully referenced. Preserve these exact two human actors and their balanced stances, faces, black hair, worn costumes, light and rocky valley. The shorter man in white-and-gold armor attacks. The taller man in orange defends and is overpowered. Ten seconds of normal-speed live-action combat, one continuous camera move. Three disciplined straight-line strikes, each with a quick delivery and immediate retraction, followed by the defender's visible reaction.

integrated_multimodal_description: [00:00.000–00:02.800] The armored fighter takes one firm step toward the orange fighter and sends his rear fist directly into the abdomen. Show the fist reach the cloth before the defender folds forward and scrapes a recovery step backward. The attacker immediately retracts the fist; he does not hold it against the body. Both keep their hips supported over their feet and remain facing each other.
[00:02.800–00:06.000] Following that same backward recovery, the armored fighter advances on a planted foot and drives one short straight punch with his lead hand into the orange fighter's late raised forearms. The guard gives way after contact, displacing the defender's shoulders and forcing another backward step. The defender tries to protect his torso and regain footing; he never counterattacks, grabs or turns his back. The attacker retracts cleanly and keeps his own balance.
[00:06.000–00:10.000] The armored fighter plants his support foot, raises his rear knee and extends one straight FRONT KICK into the defender's torso. Show boot contact before the orange fighter is driven backward along the same straight lane. The attacker retracts the kicking leg and plants the foot. The defender's feet skid, one knee and a bracing hand meet the ground, and he strains to rise while the attacker approaches. No spinning kick, sideways body rotation, somersault or rolling fall. End during that grounded recovery, with the armored fighter upright and the orange fighter still below him.
The camera physically tracks left with the retreat along one side of the fight axis. Move closer enough to read the first torso contact, then smoothly pull wider before the front kick so both feet, support and displacement remain visible. Preserve the same geography and separated body silhouettes. Foreground gravel passes against the distant mountain. Contact causes recoil, cloth movement and dust, in that order. No cut, flash or shake hides a hit. Black hair throughout; no aura, powers or transformations in this opening take.

overall_soundscape: Native H3 desert wind, firm footsteps and gritty skids, three short heavy impact sounds aligned with contact, cloth and armor movement, a knee-and-hand landing and settling grit. No dialogue, grunts, screams, vocal breathing, narration or singing.

non_diegetic_music: Restrained low instrumental drums and sustained strings underneath the impacts, without vocals or quoted melody.
